practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following ministries serves as the nodal agency for the implementation of the Champion Services Sector Scheme in India?
opts: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
practiceQuestions.sol: The Champion Services Sector Scheme is implemented by the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, to focus on 12 Champion Services Sectors for realizing their potential. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Annual Report / Economic Survey]

practiceQuestions.q: The 'Swadesh Darshan' scheme, launched for integrated development of theme-based tourist circuits, is administered by which ministry?
opts: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
practiceQuestions.sol: Swadesh Darshan scheme is a flagship scheme of the Ministry of Tourism for integrated development of theme-based tourist circuits in the country. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Tourism, Annual Report]

practiceQuestions.q: PRASHAD scheme, often seen in news, stands for:
opts: Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive
Promotion of Rural Arts, Sculpture, Handicrafts and Devotional tourism
Public Route Augmentation for Spiritual and Heritage Architecture Development
Program for Religious Architecture, Sanitation and Heritage Development
practiceQuestions.sol: PRASHAD stands for Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive, launched by the Ministry of Tourism to identify and develop pilgrim sites. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Tourism, Guidelines on PRASHAD scheme]

practiceQuestions.q: Which portal was launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to provide tele-consultation services across India?
practiceQuestions.sol: eSanjeevani is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare's national telemedicine service that operationalizes tele-consultations across the country. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, eSanjeevani Portal]

practiceQuestions.q: The 'National Logistics Policy' (NLP) was launched in India in which year?
practiceQuestions.sol: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the National Logistics Policy (NLP) in September 2022 to streamline logistics processes and reduce costs. [Primary Reference: Press Information Bureau (PIB), Ministry of Commerce and Industry]

practiceQuestions.q: What is the primary objective of the 'UDAN' (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) scheme?
opts: To promote international trade through air cargo
To enhance regional connectivity and make air travel affordable for masses
To privatize all non-metro airports in India
To provide free air ambulances to rural citizens
practiceQuestions.sol: UDAN is a regional airport development and 'Regional Connectivity Scheme' (RCS) of the Ministry of Civil Aviation aimed at making air travel affordable and widespread. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Civil Aviation, UDAN Scheme Guidelines]

practiceQuestions.q: Which platform serves as the unified digital logistics platform under the National Logistics Policy framework to provide seamless data exchange?
practiceQuestions.sol: Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP) was designed to bring all digital logistics and transport data sources onto a single dashboard for API-based integration. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, ULIP Documentation]

practiceQuestions.q: The 'Heal in India' initiative is primarily designed to promote which of the following service sectors?
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Heal in India' aims to position India as a global hub for medical value travel by streamlining visa processes, infrastructure, and standardized healthcare delivery. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / Ministry of Commerce and Industry]

practiceQuestions.q: What is the primary purpose of the 'LEADS' (Logistics Ease Across Different States) index?
opts: To rank states based on their IT-BPM sector exports
To assess and rank states/UTs on the efficiency of their logistics ecosystem
To measure tourist footfall and hospitality infrastructure development
To evaluate foreign direct investment inflow in the service sector
practiceQuestions.sol: LEADS report evaluates the logistics performance of states and union territories, ranking them to foster competitive federalism in logistics infrastructure and services. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, LEADS Report]

practiceQuestions.q: Which scheme was introduced to promote IT and IT-enabled services (ITeS) in tier-2 and tier-3 cities of India?
opts: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) initiatives / India BPO Promotion Scheme (IBPS)
Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme
practiceQuestions.sol: The India BPO Promotion Scheme (IBPS) and North-East BPO Promotion Scheme (NEBPS), under MEitY, incentivize job creation and decentralization of IT-BPM sector to smaller towns. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)]

practiceQuestions.q: How does the Champion Services Sector Scheme (CSSS) alter the structural approach of India's trade policy regarding the tertiary sector?
opts: By shifting focus from merchandise exports dominance to targeted institutional support and export diversification in high-value services
By imposing steep tariffs on foreign service providers entering the Indian domestic market
By merging all service-related ministries into a single unified super-ministry
By nationalizing all private IT-BPM and logistics firms to ensure state-controlled delivery

Historically, Indian trade policy heavily favored merchandise manufacturing incentives. CSSS marks a paradigm shift by identifying 12 Champion Sectors (such as IT, Tourism, Medical, Accounting) for dedicated funding, regulatory easing, and global market access. [Primary Reference: Economic Survey / Department of Commerce Policy Briefs]

practiceQuestions.q: What is the underlying economic rationale of integrating PM GatiShakti with the National Logistics Policy (NLP) for the service sector?
opts: To phase out private sector participation in transport infrastructure entirely
To reduce logistics costs from high double-digits to global benchmarks by synergizing multi-modal connectivity, spatial planning, and digital single-window clearance
To restrict inter-state movement of goods and services to protect local MSMEs
To replace physical infrastructure investments exclusively with software solutions

practiceQuestions.q: How do initiatives like 'Heal in India' and 'Incredible India!' function as catalysts for India's balance of payments (BoP) and invisible earnings?
opts: By increasing merchandise trade deficits through heavy import of medical hardware
By boosting services trade surplus, generating foreign exchange earnings under the 'current account' invisible receipts
By discouraging foreign nationals from visiting India to preserve domestic resources
By converting all capital account transactions into current account service flows

practiceQuestions.q: In the context of the service sector, what structural bottlenecks does the 'Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP)' seek to resolve?
opts: Lack of skilled software engineers in metropolitan cities
Information asymmetry, fragmented data silos across different ministries, and complex manual documentation procedures
High tariff barriers imposed by WTO member nations on Indian legal services
Scarcity of land for constructing luxury hotels in tier-1 pilgrim centers

practiceQuestions.q: Why has the Indian government's policy push for IT-BPM decentralized expansion (via IBPS and STPI) targeted tier-2 and tier-3 cities specifically?
opts: To mitigate urban congestion, reduce operational costs (real estate/attrition), and achieve inclusive regional economic development
Because metropolitan infrastructure has completely collapsed and cannot support broadband internet
To completely shut down IT operations in tier-1 cities like Bengaluru and Hyderabad
To comply with international mandates set by the International Monetary Fund (IMF)

practiceQuestions.q: How do government schemes in the tourism sector, such as 'PRASHAD' and 'Swadesh Darshan', leverage 'multiplier effects' in local economies?
opts: By exclusively funding foreign multinational hotel chains to build resorts
By stimulating localized demand for hospitality, local handicrafts, transportation, and guide services, thereby creating informal and formal employment clusters
By directly transferring cash subsidies to tourists visiting national monuments
By banning private tour operators to make pilgrimage sites state-monopolized

practiceQuestions.q: What is the core significance of the 'Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission' (ABDM) in transforming India's health-tech service delivery ecosystem?
opts: It provides universal health insurance cover of Rs. 5 lakhs to all Indian citizens
It establishes a seamless digital backbone enabling interoperability of health records, patient registries, and verified healthcare professional databases
It nationalizes all pharmaceutical companies to regulate medicine prices
It replaces all physical hospitals with AI-driven virtual clinics

practiceQuestions.q: How do fiscal and policy incentives under the Champion Services Sector Scheme address market failures in high-end professional services (e.g., accounting, legal, R&D)?
opts: By providing subsidized electricity and water tariffs exclusively to law firms
By supporting capacity building, global marketing campaigns, standardization, and bridging gaps in intellectual property protection and skill mismatch
By banning foreign professionals from practicing in India to protect domestic experts
By establishing state-run monopolies for auditing and legal consultancy

practiceQuestions.q: In the governance of logistics services, what is the role of the 'Logistics Ease Across Different States (LEADS)' index in promoting cooperative and competitive federalism?
opts: It penalizes states with poor logistics performance by cutting down their central tax devolution
It evaluates state-level bottlenecks, encourages adoption of best practices, and creates healthy competition among states to upgrade infrastructure and regulatory frameworks
It centralizes all state highways and warehouses under direct control of the Union Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
It fixes uniform freight rates across all states irrespective of terrain and distance

practiceQuestions.q: How do government interventions under the 'Audio Visual Services' (AVGC - Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, and Comics) promotion policy impact India's creative service economy?
opts: By restricting foreign direct investment in media and entertainment sectors
By positioning India as a global content creation powerhouse through specialized training, co-production treaties, and state-of-the-art incubation hubs
By censoring digital media platforms to prevent cultural foreign influence
By taxing video games heavily to curb youth addiction

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Champion Services Sector Scheme (CSSS):
1. It was formulated to give focused attention to 12 identified champion services sectors for promoting their export potential.
2. The Department of Commerce is the nodal agency coordinating the implementation of action plans for these sectors.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. The Champion Services Sector Scheme identifies 12 sectors (IT/ITeS, Tourism, Medical, Accounting, Legal, Communication, Construction, Financial, Environmental, Educational, Transport, Audio-Visual) and the Department of Commerce acts as the nodal coordinator. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / Economic Survey]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Logistics Policy (NLP), 2022:
1. It aims to reduce logistics cost in India to single digits by 2030, matching global standards.
2. The policy integrates four key pillars: Integration of Digital System (IDS), Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP), Ease of Logistics (ELOG), and State Engagement.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. NLP 2022 seeks to bring down logistics cost from high double-digits closer to global benchmarks by 2030, relying on integration of digital systems (IDS), ULIP, ELOG (Ease of Logistics), and state-level participation. [Primary Reference: National Logistics Policy Document, Ministry of Commerce and Industry]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the PRASHAD Scheme:
1. It is a central sector scheme fully funded by the Central Government.
2. It focuses exclusively on the development of urban transport infrastructure in metropolitan cities.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: PRASHAD (Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive) is a 100% centrally funded Central Sector Scheme. Statement 2 is incorrect because it focuses on the integrated development of identified pilgrim and heritage sites, not urban transport infrastructure in metropolitan cities. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Tourism, PRASHAD Guidelines]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the eSanjeevani platform:
1. It is India's national telemedicine service developed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC).
2. It operates in two variants: eSanjeevani Ayushman Bharat-Health and Wellness Centre (AB-HWC) and eSanjeevani OPD.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. eSanjeevani was developed by C-DAC (Mohali) for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and functions via two major verticals: provider-to-provider (AB-HWC) and doctor-to-patient (eSanjeevani OPD). [Primary Reference: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, eSanjeevani Portal]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP):
1. It is designed to act as a single window for all logistics-related clearances and approvals from environmental bodies.
2. It is built on the philosophy of 'Open Source' and 'API-first' architecture to enable private and public entities to access transport data securely.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because environmental clearances fall under platforms like PARIVESH, whereas ULIP is specifically for logistics data integration (transport, toll, FASTag, cargo tracking). Statement 2 is correct as ULIP operates on an API-based architecture for seamless data sharing between stakeholders. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, ULIP Guidelines]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Heal in India' initiative:
1. It is an initiative aimed at promoting India as a premier destination for Medical Value Travel (MVT).
2. It involves the creation of a digital portal providing comprehensive information on accredited hospitals, treatment packages, and medical visa facilitation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. 'Heal in India' targets medical value travel by streamlining healthcare delivery, creating multi-lingual digital portals, and simplifying visa processes for international patients. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / Ministry of Commerce and Industry]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'India BPO Promotion Scheme' (IBPS):
1. It aims to incentivize the establishment of BPO/ITeS operations exclusively in tier-1 metropolitan cities to maximize output.
2. It is implemented under the Digital India programme by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because IBPS specifically focuses on tier-2 and tier-3 cities to decentralize IT-BPM employment away from tier-1 cities. Statement 2 is correct as it is administered by MeitY under Digital India. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'LEADS' (Logistics Ease Across Different States) report:
1. It is released annually by the NITI Aayog in collaboration with the World Bank.
2. It ranks states and Union Territories based on a perception survey and objective parameters regarding logistics infrastructure and services.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because LEADS report is prepared and released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (specifically Logistics Division), not NITI Aayog and World Bank. Statement 2 is correct as it relies on both stakeholder perception and hard data parameters. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, LEADS Report]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Swadesh Darshan 2.0' initiative:
1. It aims to develop sustainable and responsible tourist destinations following a tourist-centric approach.
2. It completely discards the concept of theme-based circuits and focuses exclusively on single mega-cities.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: Swadesh Darshan 2.0 evolves from theme-based circuits to developing sustainable, responsible destination-centric tourism. Statement 2 is incorrect because while it shifts towards destination-driven development instead of rigid circuits, it does not restrict focus to single mega-cities; rather, it targets diverse destinations across states. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Tourism, Swadesh Darshan 2.0 Guidelines]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM):
1. Creation of Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) is mandatory for every citizen born in India under this mission.
2. The National Health Authority (NHA) is the implementing agency for ABDM.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because creation of an ABHA ID is voluntary, not mandatory. Statement 2 is correct as the National Health Authority (NHA) under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare is the designated implementing agency for ABDM. [Primary Reference: National Health Authority (NHA), ABDM Guidelines]
